Extraction of metal from upper surface of earth is called Surface mining

Hydrological Drought occurs when physical water shortage to effect the human health
well-being and quality of life.

Submerge of low-lying area and human settlement is due to Flood

Fuel that obtained from biomass is called Biomass energy

The variety and variability among all the living organisms is called Biodiversity

Direct harvesting food from different sources means Direct/Consumptive _ values of
biodiversity.
